config.craftable.server.partial_executio: NEVER: disabled. CONFIRM: always review. EXPLICIT_SAFE: explicit safe preparation; other plans require confirmation. Single C never consumes partial inputs.
config.craftable.server.surplus_delivery: REQUIRE_SPACE: all outputs must fit. DROP_OVERFLOW: primary output must fit; excess surplus is dropped and can be lost.
Each batch executes the root recipe once (four sticks per stick batch). Intermediate steps have a separate safety limit.
config.craftable.client.partial_policy.t: May only tighten world rules: NEVER, always CONFIRM, or explicit safe preparation.
config.craftable.client.allow_surplus_dr: When off, all outputs must fit. Enabling this never bypasses a server ban on surplus drops.
config.craftable.client.double_press_mil: Default 350; range 150–800. Release the key between presses; key repeat does not count.
